msaii_overview.title: MSAII Program Overview
paragraphs: The Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence and Innovation (MSAII) is a 16-month program in the School of Computer Science.
Students work in teams on an industry-sponsored capstone project and take courses across machine learning and language technologies.

msaii_curriculum.title: MSAII Curriculum
paragraphs: The MSAII curriculum requires 195 units in total, including core courses, electives and the capstone sequence.
Core courses include Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision and AI Engineering.
Electives may be taken from the Language Technologies Institute and the Machine Learning Department.

msaii_capstone.title: MSAII Capstone Sequence
paragraphs: The capstone spans three semesters and accounts for 72 of the 195 units required for the degree.
Each capstone team delivers a working AI product prototype to its industry sponsor at the end of the program.

msaii_admissions.title: MSAII Admissions
paragraphs: Applicants must submit a resume, a statement of purpose and three letters of recommendation.
The minimum TOEFL iBT score is 100; IELTS applicants need an overall band of 7.5.
The application deadline for Fall 2027 entry is December 10, 2026.
GRE scores are optional for the Fall 2027 cycle.

mscs_admissions.title: MSCS Admissions
paragraphs: The MSCS program requires GRE General Test scores for Fall 2027 applicants.
The MSCS application deadline for Fall 2027 entry is December 2, 2026.

msml_curriculum.title: MSML Curriculum
paragraphs: MSML students complete the core courses 10-701 Introduction to Machine Learning, 10-708 Probabilistic Graphical Models and 36-705 Intermediate Statistics.
A minimum of 96 units of core coursework is required before electives are counted.

uiuc_mcs.title: Master of Computer Science (MCS)
paragraphs: The Master of Computer Science (MCS) requires 32 credit hours of coursework and no thesis.
Applicants should have a minimum GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale in the last two years of undergraduate study.
The online and on-campus MCS tracks award the same degree.
